worldcombat.skill.headcharge.summary: An unstoppable plowing headbutt: duck, flare the afro and drive in a straight line, hurling everything in the way without stopping. A whiff just carries you past.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.description: The head deals %1$s contact damage to each target, charging up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block collision radius.

For each target hit the user takes %1$s%% of that target's actual damage as recoil; every target after the first takes %2$s%% of the power and is shoved %3$s blocks, and a full charge kicks up %4$s fur motes.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.hunt.on: Homing: the charge steers toward the nearest enemy (with a turn limit), catching targets that sidestep - at the cost of power, knockback and a longer wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.hunt.off: Straight line: maximum power and knockback, but one sidestep puts the target clear.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.growth.0: From level %1$s the charge power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.growth.1: From level %1$s the charge power rises to %2$s and the through fraction to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.use.0: Hurl a line of enemies in one straight charge
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.use.1: Deliver a powerful charge at the cost of recoil
worldcombat.skill.headcharge.use.2: Chase a sidestepping target with the homing form
On: the charge steers toward the nearest enemy (with a turn limit), catching targets that sidestep - at the cost of power, knockback and a longer wind-up. Off: a dead straight line with maximum power and knockback, but one sidestep puts the target clear.
Within this distance the user starts the charge; smaller stays in your face, larger charges from further out.
On: prefer starting the charge when more enemies are lined up behind the target. Off: choose by threat alone.
